label: v3-ship-1
pipeline: V3/compose case 2 (several sequences; references picked by hand, the state manager assumed perfect)
brief: A three-clip battleship sequence, widescreen, about 15 seconds per clip. Clip one: inside the ship, on the bridge, the captain and crew spot the enemy ship and the captain gives the command to fire. Clip two: outside, our battleship fires its main guns at the enemy ship on the horizon. Clip three: back on the same bridge with the same crew, the small tactical screen shows the enemy ship sinking, and the bridge celebrates.

plan.story:
Aboard the battleship Resolute, Captain Vale stands on the bridge with her lookout and helmsman as the ship crosses a cold, quiet sea. Through the slanted front windows, an enemy cruiser emerges on the horizon. The lookout points it out, and Vale raises her binoculars to confirm the contact. Beside them, a small tactical screen tracks the distant vessel. The captain lowers her binoculars and gives a clear command to fire.

Outside, the Resolute’s massive forward turrets train toward the enemy. The main guns discharge in a single coordinated salvo, throwing orange flame and dense smoke across the gray deck. The hull shudders beneath the blast while the enemy remains a small, unmistakable silhouette on the horizon.

Back on the same bridge, the same three sailors watch the tactical screen. Its amber display shows the enemy cruiser listing, settling beneath the waterline, and disappearing. For a moment, everyone holds still. Then the lookout cheers, the helmsman pumps a fist, and Vale permits herself a relieved smile as the bridge breaks into celebration.

sequences.prose: Inside a narrow steel bridge with slanted front windows, a central chart table, and cool overhead lamps, Captain Vale, a woman with cropped dark hair, a navy double-breasted coat, and brass binoculars, confirms the contact. The lookout, a young man with curly black hair, a navy sailor shirt, and a red headset, points through the glass at a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow. The helmsman, a woman with a blond braid, a navy sailor shirt, and rolled sleeves, holds course. Beside them sits a small square tactical screen with a thick black bezel and amber graphics. Vale lowers her binoculars: “Fire main battery!”

sequences.brief: Inside Resolute’s bridge, a narrow steel room with slanted front windows overlooking slate-blue sea, a central chart table stands beneath cool overhead lamps. Captain Vale, a woman with cropped dark hair, a navy double-breasted coat, and brass binoculars, studies the horizon. Beside her, the lookout, a young man with curly black hair, a navy sailor shirt, and a red headset, points through the glass. Far away, a small pale-gray cruiser shows one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow. The helmsman, a woman with a blond braid, a navy sailor shirt, and rolled sleeves, holds course. A small square tactical screen with a thick black bezel casts amber graphics beside them. Vale confirms the contact, lowers her binoculars, and orders, “Fire main battery!” Use cold late-afternoon daylight, steel-blue shadows, and restrained, realistic naval-war-film photography. This is clip 1 of 3; the exterior salvo belongs to the next clip and is not shown here.

sequences.prose: A low exterior tracking view reveals Resolute, a dark-gray dreadnought battleship with twin-gun main turrets and a red band around its forward funnel, crossing an open slate-blue sea with low swells, a flat horizon, and thin overcast. Its forward turrets finish training toward a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow, distant on the horizon. The camera holds both ships in the same firing axis. Resolute fires one coordinated main-gun salvo: brilliant muzzle flashes, heavy barrel recoil, and expanding smoke. The camera trembles with the concussion, then steadies as smoke drifts above the deck. Do not show the enemy sinking yet.
sequences.first_frame: Resolute fills the left foreground in a low three-quarter bow view, its red funnel band visible above the turrets. The same enemy cruiser from the bridge sighting sits far to the right on the horizon, clearly separated from the gun barrels.

sequences.brief: On the open slate-blue sea beneath thin overcast, Resolute fills a low exterior tracking view: a dark-gray dreadnought battleship with twin-gun main turrets and a red band around its forward funnel. Low swells roll alongside its hull; no people are visible. Far beyond its bows, a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow appears small against the flat horizon. Keep both ships aligned along the same firing axis as Resolute’s forward turrets finish training toward that distant target. One coordinated main-gun salvo erupts: brilliant muzzle flashes, heavy barrel recoil, then expanding smoke. Let the camera tremble with the concussion before steadying as smoke drifts above the deck. Use cold late-afternoon daylight, cool steel-blue shadows, restrained saturation, and realistic naval-war-film photography, with gunfire and sea noise but no dialogue. This is clip 2 of 3; the bridge crew’s sinking confirmation belongs to the next clip and is not shown here.

Its diagram depicts a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow, listing and sinking below a waterline. The lookout, a young man with curly black hair, a navy sailor shirt, and a red headset, cheers. The helmsman, a woman with a blond braid, a navy sailor shirt, and rolled sleeves, pumps a fist. Vale smiles; all three celebrate.

sequences.brief: Inside Resolute’s bridge, slanted front windows overlook distant slate-blue sea beyond a central chart table under cool overhead lamps. Captain Vale, a woman with cropped dark hair, a navy double-breasted coat, and brass binoculars, watches a small square tactical screen with a thick black bezel and amber graphics. In close view, its amber diagram represents a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white bow stripe, listing and descending below a waterline; no actual sinking is visible outside. The lookout, a young man with curly black hair, a navy sailor shirt, and a red headset, cheers, “She’s going down!” The helmsman, a woman with a blond braid, a navy sailor shirt, and rolled sleeves, pumps a fist. Vale smiles; all three celebrate. Cold late-afternoon light mixes with warm amber screen glow in restrained steel-blue realism. This is clip 3 of 3; no exterior sinking or subsequent action is shown, and no next clip follows.
